lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued compensation
lines.why: Wages, bonuses and benefits earned but not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: On October 7, 2025, the Company entered into a separate digital currency loan agreement with BlueFin Labs Inc. (“BlueFin”) under which the Company lent 2,000,000 SUI tokens to BlueFin for a fee equal to 5.0% of all revenues generated by BlueFin’s decentralized exchange, paid in SUI tokens.
In consideration, the Company is entitled to receive a fee equal to 5.0 % of all revenues generated by BlueFin’s decentralized exchange, paid in SUI tokens.
Unlike traditional blockchain models that rely on sequential transaction execution, SUI’s architecture enables parallel transaction execution, significantly increasing throughput.
The Sui network relies on a network of validator nodes that agree on the order and validity of transactions.
Our significant investment in SUI depends on third‑party custodians and trade execution partners for the safekeeping, transfer, and management of our digital assets.

The pace of worldwide growth in the adoption and use of SUI may depend on public familiarity with digital assets, ease of buying, accessing or gaining exposure to SUI, institutional demand for SUI as an investment asset, the participation of traditional financial institutions in the digital assets industry, and the availability and popularity of alternatives to SUI.
Rule 3a-2 is a safe harbor and we may rely on any exemption or exclusion from investment company status available to us under the 1940 Act at any given time.
We depend on digital technologies, including information systems, infrastructure and cloud applications and services, including those belonging to third parties with whom we deal.

We have not made a significant investment in data security protection (preferring instead to rely upon the data-security know-how and investments made by the third parties with whom we deal and upon whom we rely), and we may not be sufficiently protected against such occurrences.
Our principal sources of income now include staking rewards from our SUI holdings, realized and unrealized gains or losses on digital assets, and rewards earned through protocol participation.

In the long term, our liquidity will depend on our ability to generate cash from operations, the performance and realizable value of our SUI holdings, and our ability to access capital markets or secure additional financing arrangements.

s.t: During the same period, the Company also invested $ 3.0 million through a contractual alternative investment vehicle to acquire a beneficial interest in the preferred shares of Recursive Superintelligence, a private artificial intelligence research company focused on developing self-improving AI systems.

Cash used in investing activities during nine months ended September 30, 2026 was primarily attributable to purchases of SuiUSDe amounting to $10.0 million under the Company’s SUI treasury strategy, a $3.0 million SAFE investment in Nof1 Holdings, Inc., an artificial intelligence research and trading technology company, and a $3.0 million investment in Recursive Superintelligence, an artificial intelligence research company focused on developing self-improving AI systems, through an investment vehicle providing the Company with an indirect beneficial interest in the underlying equity interests.

During the nine months ended September 30, 2026, we made $6.0 million of strategic investment in artificial intelligence companies, consisting of a $3.0 million investment in Nof1 Holdings, Inc. through a SAFE and a $3.0 million investment in Recursive Superintelligence through an investment structure providing the Company with an indirect beneficial interest in preferred equity interests.
